# Video script: Two outflow tracts, one crossing

> Verified content.

Unit D5 | Target length: 6 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Split screen: hand sliding the probe towards the head / clip moving from four-chamber to LVOT | From the four chambers, sweep towards the head. The first vessel you meet leaves the left ventricle. | IS23-055 |
| 2 | LVOT clip with septum and anterior aortic wall traced | Its front wall runs straight on from the septum. It does not divide. The valve is thin and opens freely. | IS23-052, IS23-059, IS23-060 |
| 3 | Split screen: small rotation of the hand / LVOT opening out | The other way in: from the four chambers, rotate towards the fetal right shoulder. | IS23-057 |
| 4 | RVOT clip with bifurcation labelled | Tilt towards the head again. A second vessel, from the right ventricle, crossing the first almost at right angles, and dividing. | IS23-058, IS23-064, IS23-065 |
| 5 | Side-by-side stills of both arteries with calipers hidden | About the same size, the pulmonary artery slightly larger. A major difference needs further evaluation. | IS23-051, IS23-065 |
